name: Prusa MK3S 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
M862.3 P "MK3S" ; printer model check
M862.1 P[nozzle_diameter] ; nozzle diameter check
M115 U3.13.0 ; tell printer latest fw version
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; set extruder temp
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for extruder temp
G28 W ; home all without mesh bed level
G80 ; mesh bed leveling
{if filament_settings_id[initial_tool]=~/.*Prusament PA11.*/}
G1 Z0.3 F720
G1 Y-3 F1000 ; go outside print area
G92 E0
G1 X60 E9 F1000 ; intro line
G1 X100 E9 F1000 ; intro line
{else}
G1 Z0.2 F720
G1 Y-3 F1000 ; go outside print area
G92 E0
G1 X60 E9 F1000 ; intro line
G1 X100 E12.5 F1000 ; intro line
{endif}
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode: ; simulation end code intentionally has no E or flow scaling
printer_notes:
Don't remove the following keywords! These keywords are used in the "compatible printer" condition of the print and filament profiles to link the particular print and filament profiles to this printer profile.
PRINTER_VENDOR_PRUSA3D
PRINTER_MODEL_MK3
